text:
mira: @channel quick heads-up — planning a coordinated bump tomorrow 10:00 PT for the runtime (0.9.1 -> 0.10.0). Runtime includes kernel K2 that changes KV-cache key layout. Console + SDKs need pinned deps and changelog entries before cut. Can folks confirm readiness and any blockers?

sanjay: got it. can you paste a short checklist? I can own API side pins. :+1:

mira: checklist: 1) runtime tag v0.10.0 + release notes; 2) api schema compat check (no breaking REST changes) — if any, bump API minor; 3) console UI flag + changelog; 4) js/py SDK dependency bump + integration tests; 5) dedicated capacity windows scheduled; 6) canary rollout plan.

kelly: console: I'll add a feature flag and a small note in the changelog. PR target ready — just need the runtime tag to link. PR #5123.
dave: API: there is one tiny param rename in the /generate endpoint (force_stream -> stream_mode) — it's a rename, should be non-breaking if SDK maps it. I'll add a compatibility shim in runtime to accept old param for one release.

priya: SDKs: js + python need 1) dependency bump 2) regenerate swagger client 3) run e2e. I'm blocked on the swagger schema update — can someone push the generated schema to the repo?
mira: @priya I'll trigger the schema regen after merging runtime PRs. will post the generated openapi.json here.

release-bot: Deploy schedule: canary window 10:15-10:45 PT, full roll 11:00-11:30 PT. SLOs monitored. :robot_face:
devops-bot: Heads-up: Dedicated pools reserved 09:50-12:00 PT. No other infra ops windows. :calendar:

sanjay: dave — thanks for shim plan. can you add a brief note in the api changelog that stream_mode maps to legacy? avoids confusion for SDK consumers.
dave: yep will add one-liner.

mira: snippet for SDK bump (js):
```
# in packages/js-sdk/package.json
"dependencies": {
  "@redwood/runtime": "^0.10.0"
}
# create PR title: chore(js-sdk): bump runtime -> 0.10.0, regen client
```

kelly: tagging console PR now with v0.10.0 reference. also adding migration note in the UI release banner doc.

priya: I can run e2e at 09:30 PT tomorrow and again during canary. need the regen file by 09:15.
mira: will have openapi.json posted by 09:00.

sanjay: quick check — does anyone expect schema changes to require semver major on SDK?
dave: no major — only rename + optional fields. shim covers old param. release notes will mention it.

mira: final ask: drop one-line changelog bullets in your PRs and ping this thread. I'll coordinate the actual cut and update the release checklist. :eyes: :shipit:

kelly: done — PR linked, changelog bullet added.

priya: will post test results and links to test run logs in this thread after 09:30.

mira: thanks everyone. if no major surprises, we're green for the coordinated bump. I'll send the final cut message 09:45 PT.

release-bot: Reminder: don't forget to update internal compat table: https://internal.redwood/sheet/compat (auto-update will run after tags).
